patch_description: Diversify the successful centre-plus-four-rings prior without abandoning its useful threefold structure. The existing restarts differ only by small radial and phase noise, so they tend to enter the same hull/sign basin. This edit cycles among: the original symmetric rings, a mildly elliptical affine embedding, and independently perturbed angular/radial ring roles. The latter permits radial exchanges between nearby rings and changes hull/interior combinatorics before annealing. Survivor selection is also made family-diverse: the best trajectory from each prior family is guaranteed a long refinement budget, while the final survivor remains the strongest remaining candidate by measured primary objective.
